question: Who became the 52ⁿd Chief Justice of India on 14 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai** was appointed as the **52nd Chief Justice of India** on **14 May 2025**.
 
• He succeeded **Sanjiv Khanna**, who served as the Chief Justice of India before him.
 
• Justice Gavai is known for his significant contributions to the **Indian judiciary** and has delivered several landmark judgments during his tenure as a Supreme Court judge.
 
• He has extensive experience in handling cases related to **constitutional law, civil law, and criminal law**, which made him a strong candidate for the position of Chief Justice of India.
 
• As the Chief Justice of India, Justice Gavai is responsible for leading the judiciary and ensuring its independence, integrity, and efficiency in upholding the **rule of law**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chief Justice of India (CJI):**

 
 
• The Chief Justice of India is the **head of the judiciary system of India** and presides over the **Supreme Court of India**.
 
• The appointment of the Chief Justice is governed by the **Constitution of India** under Article **124**, which states that the President of India appoints the Chief Justice.
 
• The Chief Justice plays a crucial role in constitutional interpretation, adjudication of disputes, and ensuring justice for citizens.
 
 
 
• **Justice Bhushan Ramkrishna Gavai:**
 
 
• Born on **24 November 1959**, Justice Gavai hails from Maharashtra and has served in various judicial capacities before becoming the Chief Justice of India.
 
• He is known for his expertise in handling cases related to **fundamental rights**, **environmental issues**, and **public interest litigation**.
 
• He was elevated as a Supreme Court judge in **May 2019** and has been part of several important benches.
 
 
 
• **Selection Process of the Chief Justice:**
 
 
• The appointment of the Chief Justice follows the **seniority principle**, where the most senior judge of the Supreme Court is considered for the position.
 
• The **President of India** consults the outgoing Chief Justice and appoints the new Chief Justice based on their recommendation.
 
 
 
• **Role and Responsibilities:**
 
 
• The Chief Justice of India is responsible for constituting benches, assigning cases, and ensuring the smooth functioning of the Supreme Court.
 
• They act as the **guardian of the Constitution** and play a vital role in safeguarding **democracy** and ensuring justice for all.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Judicial Independence:** The Chief Justice ensures that the judiciary remains independent from executive and legislative interference.
 
• **Landmark Judgments:** Justice Gavai has been part of benches delivering significant judgments on issues such as **environmental conservation** and **human rights.**
 
• **Supreme Court Composition:** The Supreme Court comprises the Chief Justice and a maximum of **34 other judges**, as per constitutional provisions.
 
• **Judicial Reforms:** The Chief Justice often advocates for reforms to improve the efficiency and accessibility of the judiciary.
